title: Wolf Spider Companion
html:
Wolf Spider Companion is a variant of  Ranger's Companion which is a Subclass Feature of Rangers learned immediately upon choosing the Beast Master subclass. This ability allows the Beast Master to call upon their animal companion to fight and aid them in combat.

Description

Summon a wolf spider that can shoot  Webs and  Poison enemies with its  Bite.

Summon a Wolf Spider companion that can poison enemies and shoot webs from afar.

 Venomous Bite ()
Bite a target to deal 1d8 + Dexterity ModifierPiercing damage and possibly  Poison it.
 Web ()
Expel a thick, flammable webbing that slows creatures within and possibly  Enwebs them.
Prey's Scent
You deal an additional 1d6⁠⁠Physical damage to creatures marked by your Ranger's  Hunter's Mark.
Web Walker
Isn't slowed down by  Web surfaces, and can't be  Enwebbed by them.
Darkvision
Can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft).

Your wolf spider companion has 10 Hit Points and 14  Armour Class.

    • Arānea Aculeāta – barbed spider
